mdns_service_enumeration.title: mDNS Service Enumeration Possible
mdns_service_enumeration.description: Multicast DNS (mDNS, RFC 6762) is responding to service-discovery queries on UDP/5353. The host advertises its available services (HTTP, IPP, AirPlay, etc.) without authentication.
mdns_service_enumeration.impact: Service inventory disclosure: an attacker on the same broadcast domain (or one with mDNS-relayed traffic across VLANs) learns what services run on the host. This narrows the target surface for follow-up attacks. Common on consumer devices, printers, and macOS/iOS systems that haven't been hardened.
mdns_service_enumeration.remediation: For server systems, disable mDNS unless required (most servers don't need it). On Linux: `systemctl disable avahi-daemon`. On macOS: configurable via launchctl. For network printers and IoT devices, restrict mDNS to specific VLANs at the switch level (no L2 relay to user segments).
